theme: Smart Multi-Surface Theme: Admin & Operator Panels use clean Light Mode for high legibility in bright offices. Kiosk uses High-Contrast Light Mode with Brand Colors. TV Monitor Display MUST use Dark Mode (Crystal Glassmorphism over deep blue abstract background) to reduce glare and make the glowing numbers pop.

typography.setup: MUST import Poppins via CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap'); and set as default sans font in tailwind config.

hierarchy.TV_Monitor_Main_Number: text-[15vw] sm:text-[20vw] font-black tracking-tighter leading-none tabular-nums text-white drop-shadow-2xl
hierarchy.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.Labels: text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans. Use Poppins exclusively as requested.
Always use 'tabular-nums' for queue numbers so they don't shift when changing.
Use extremely tight tracking on massive headings.

colors.archetype: Authority & Clarity (Swiss & High-Contrast tailored for Trust - Bank/Clinic)

palette.accent: Amber-500 (Tailwind text-amber-500) for the active 'Now Serving' highlight.

rules: NO Teal Green or Teal Blue for dashboards.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content; always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent color.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use Text Shadow on the TV Monitor over backgrounds.

surfaces: TV Monitor: The 'Crystal' Variant (Glassmorphism). bg-black/40 with backdrop-blur-2xl and 1px border-white/10.
Admin/Operator: The 'Tactile' Variant (Neumorphism-lite). Flat white cards, shadow-sm, border-slate-200.
Kiosk: Large solid blocks with rounded-3xl, prominent shadow-xl on active elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use layered shadows. TV Monitor numbers get heavy drop-shadow to pop off the screen.

tv_monitor.structure: Top: Header (Logo + Time). Middle: Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Left 8 cols: 'Now Serving' Massive Card. Right 4 cols: 'Waiting List' vertical list. Bottom: react-fast-marquee Ticker.

kiosk.classes: min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8
kiosk.structure: Giant touch targets (min-h-[120px]). Use bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8) for selecting Service (e.g., Teller, CS, Pharmacy).

admin_dashboard.structure: Use exact spacing, dense cards for queue stats. Left sidebar for navigation.

operator_panel.classes: max-w-5xl mx-auto p-6 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8
operator_panel.structure: Col 1-2: Current Queue details. Col 3: Massive action buttons (Call Next, Recall, Complete).

components.buttons: Rounded-2xl or pill-shaped. Kiosk buttons must be massive (p-8 or p-10) to accommodate touch. Use hover:-translate-y-1 transition.
components.cards: Shadcn standard but override radius to rounded-2xl or 3xl for kiosk and TV monitor.
components.tables: Admin panel uses dense Shadcn tables. No card wrappers if possible, flat edges.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the informational ticker at the bottom of the TV display.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for Kiosk 'Ticket Printed' confirmation with simulated paper receipt design.

rules: Use framer-motion for the TV Monitor 'Now Serving' number change. It MUST pulse or slide in dramatically to catch attention.
Operator panel buttons should have micro-interactions (scale 0.98 on tap).
Kiosk flow must use smooth crossfade transitions between steps.

images.description: Deep blue and purple flowing shapes abstract background
images.category: TV Monitor Background (Full screen absolute cover under glassmorphism)

guidelines: Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Kiosk contrast must be extremely high for visually impaired users.
TV monitor requires audio cues (TTS) to complement visual changes.

technical_instructions: Install libraries: framer-motion, lucide-react, sonner, react-fast-marquee, recharts.
Implement Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) for the TV Monitor. Example text: 'Nomor antrian, A, satu, silakan menuju, loket, satu'. Ensure it uses 'id-ID' locale.
Setup a simulated WebSocket or SSE hook for real-time state sync between Operator Panel, TV Monitor, and Kiosk.
Kiosk sequence: Home -> Select Service -> Print Ticket Modal -> Auto return home.
Build Shadcn components: Button, Card, Dialog, Table, Input, Select, Badge.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make the TV Monitor look like a high-end airport lounge display.
Do NOT center align the Admin app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always use modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl buttons with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
